title: Page 321
transc:
No 4
McCaine Winch.  Wash. Apl. 14. 1865
Rebecca Morgan Dandruff fawn The Andrew
famish & Fred flagrant lisbon will
leave for Lees large vista under
loath of Panther Gamble hool meet
Consent at all Deon Tyler ----
Wooster says that all able bodied 
relay hoove no payrolls artobe judged
Is it meant by this that
all lobsters artobe judged pump very
few of them have any payroll
Aromatic 


No 2  7 Pm
Caldwell Bunkesville Va Wash. Apl 15. 1865
Minnie Jones for negus tulip Flora is in motion
after Jamaica's penn yard It may be that instead
of Woodford ring Java may romance his usual tack
ticks of shading whenever too hard prest stick If
so fortune has not got pedlar Enuf to head 
off & plainfield his persia yacht I want you
to get your pekin in readiness to push wick
& make up this deficiency if it becomes stomach
fortune Expected to occupy homer on the Hudson but
does not say which way the robin is swindling
yard I hope to hear farther from him almost
Every hour & will inform you when I do
Madrid
